integrity: The analytic proof specifies normalization and gives explicit trigonometric integrals; the packaged checker recomputes all critical coefficients and confirms sample trajectories. Numerical tests alone are not a proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact first-order asymptotics only for the two small-amplitude Hopf cycles, not the full global period function. Inaccessible historical equivalences remain a priority risk; no independent audit.
title: Opposite Hopf stabilities with simultaneous positive period drift in an invariant-line quadratic flow
